THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 21, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Alejandra Ramirez, Chair  Richard Lewis, Director
Eva Melgarejo, Vice Chair  Ruben Minjarez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MEGGAN.SORENSEN@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54069  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54070  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of Wednesday, November 19, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54071  Recommendation to approve a HOME Investment Partnerships Program (HOME)
  loan in the amount of $2,000,000 to AMCAL Multi Housing (AMCAL) for the
  development of 946 Linden Avenue;

  Authorize President to negotiate the Affordable Housing Loan Agreement with
  AMCAL; and

  Authorize President or designee to negotiate and execute any and all documents
  necessary related to the Loan Agreement.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54072  Recommendation to receive and file Community Outreach Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:36 PM, Chair Ramirez called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Chambers, Sides, Melgarejo, Ramirez

  Commissioners Absent: Esparza, Lewis, Minjarez

Neighborhood Improvement Officer, Kjell Stava, Real Estate Project Coordinator, Adam Jacobs,
Deputy City Attorney, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

Director Esparza, Director Lewis, and Director Minjarez are excused from the meeting.

  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Esparza, Lewis, Minjarez
